# Informed endomorphic reference-Meaning study

This context and the four complete first projects were saved before any CLI
check in this session. The author is the Codex assistant with access to the
current repository, #46 and its historical exact-equation limitation, the
checked-operation Reference, `apply_contract` implementation and existing
function-evidence tests. No external model was invoked; the deployed model
identifier and sampling settings are not recorded. This is informed design
research, not a blind authoring benchmark.

The desired `reference(reference_h)` Meaning form is an unadopted candidate.
Its first check is expected to reject parsing; that rejection establishes no
downstream Meaning rule. The other three projects deliberately use the existing
`apply_contract` API. They are controls, not repairs or implementation of the
desired form. The ordinary project entry and the explicitly selected Raw entry
are observed separately and may expose different current profile limits.

The requested reference is independently written H. Exact linear algebra gives
HHH = H, while identity and -H differ from H. A final H followed by measurement
on the positive closed control should return classical zero. A probability
check alone cannot reject -H; the independent equation must preserve phase.
The literal H matrix and a wrong-axis pair are independently exercised in
`tests/function_evidence.rs`; that host regression was frozen and run before
this source session and is not a source-level Meaning implementation.

All source probes use one qubit. The existing host regression uses at most two.
No general arrows, rectangular Meaning, QFT, new primitives, schema changes or
large cases are part of this study. Accepted IR/reference equality, source
preservation and human specification adequacy remain separate judgments. The
adopted QS/PR/RS/EXACT obligations and two scoped guarantees remain unchanged.
